entities.name: Nadia Bey
entities.description: A young woman of Innistrad trained by her uncle Master Bey to fight darkness in the name of Avacyn; she is attacked by undead in her own room.

entities.name: Master Bey
entities.description: Nadia's uncle and trainer, an infamous hunter of the dark who sets up a deadly test for her.

entities.name: Kasten
entities.description: Nadia's hound, rescued by her as a puppy from an open grave in Nephalia.

entities.name: Jorgson
entities.description: One of Master Bey's men, told to load the corpses onto the wagon.

entities.name: Dead Cathar
entities.description: A large one-eyed ghoul in a tattered army uniform that was once a cathar of the Avacynian Church.

entities.name: Stitched Girl
entities.description: A skaab in the shape of a girl in a bloody gown with blades stitched to her fingers stubs.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The Archangel whose name wards invoke and whose light Nadia calls upon.

entities.name: Bey Manor
entities.description: The walled and warded manor house where Nadia lives with her uncle.

entities.name: Gatstaf Village
entities.description: A village near Bey Manor whose people doubt the Angels.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where vampires, werewolves and undead threaten the faithful.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A wild region of Innistrad where cottages were once kept safe by wards.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region on whose border Nadia and her uncle destroyed a nest of devils.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Region where Nadia rescued Kasten near a port town.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City from which a messenger arrives reporting a situation.

entities.name: Avacynian Church
entities.description: The church of Avacyn, whose soldiers are called cathars.

entities.name: Discontents
entities.description: Villagers of Gatstaf who speak doubts about the Angels.

events.summary: Nadia wakes in the night to the sound of clinking approaching her door.
events.quote: Besides, the noise was moving down the corridor toward her door.

events.summary: Nadia recalls destroying a nest of devils with her uncle two days earlier.
events.quote: She and her uncle—the infamous Master Bey—had destroyed a nest of devils on the border with Stensia two days earlier.

events.summary: Nadia finds Kasten gone and her dagger missing, realizing someone has been in her room.
events.quote: So someone had been inside her room.

events.summary: Ghouls attack through the roof and window; Nadia kicks the first from the window.
events.quote: Nadia leapt across the room, kicking it in the head before it could drag itself into the room.

events.summary: Nadia finds her weapon chest padlocked and deduces her uncle arranged the attack.
events.quote: Her uncle had set this up.

events.summary: Dead Cathar breaks in and Nadia tackles it under her quilt.
events.quote: Nadia sprang off the bed and tackled the zombie, her slender frame just barely enough to upend it.

events.summary: Stitched Girl drops through the roof, crushing Dead Cathar's skull, and attacks Nadia.
events.quote: It landed on the dead cathar with a satisfying crack, hopefully shattering its skull.

events.summary: Nadia flings hot coals at Stitched Girl, setting it ablaze.
events.quote: The embers struck the skaab's eyes.

events.summary: Nadia finds holy water in her cloak and uses it with Avacyn's power to put out the flames.
events.quote: She felt a rush of wind, as if Avacyn's wings were beating the air itself.

events.summary: Nadia batters the burned skaab out the window.
events.quote: Too brittle and burned to fight, Stitched Girl let itself be steered to the window frame, where it tumbled into the darkness without a fight.

events.summary: A massive skaab smashes through the door and begins to choke Nadia.
events.quote: The skaab picked her up by her throat and flung her into the wall.

events.summary: Nadia recalls her family's deaths: her father to a werewolf, her mother to a vampire.
events.quote: Her father had died to a werewolf in the field near their house.

events.summary: Nadia, remembering her parents' farm, unleashes a holy spell that destroys the skaab from inside.
events.quote: The moment she gave in to memory, energy pulsed through her body and seared her would-be murderer.

events.summary: Master Bey appears, lets Kasten through, and announces they leave for Thraben in an hour.
events.quote: "A messenger from Thraben arrived," he told her. "There's a situation in Thraben. We leave in an hour."

events.summary: Master Bey tells Nadia she did well; she goes to bury the dead.

relations.quote: At the threshold, he stopped and looked back at his niece.
Kasten was always at her side.

relations.note: trains her in the fight against darkness
relations.quote: Pain was an expected part of both the training and the holy fight against darkness.

relations.note: formerly a cathar before being raised as undead
relations.quote: This fiend had once been a cathar, a soldier of the Avacynian Church.
He motioned two of his men inside the room.
